moments.action: Held close-up of Lynn in a pale blouse, speaking straight down the lens in an empty white hall; she starts steady and her mouth keeps moving as the take runs on without a cut.

Insert of a phone chat where Pat's thread ends with 'Lin left the chat', then cut away to a warm wood-panelled party: Pat turns and talks off-screen, and the reverse lands on Grace smiling back at him.
Close-up of hands kneading a bare leg, then the camera pulls back past a table of empty bottles to Pat and Grace sprawled together on the couch, the massage over and both slumped in the mess.
Back to Lynn alone in the white hall, holding the camera's gaze through a long take; by the end of the shot she has dropped her eyes to the floor and stopped speaking.

In a dim office a woman in a black blazer sits behind a desk facing two people shot from behind; the scene cuts to a clipboard close-up of a school-crested letter already carrying a handwritten signature.
A congratulatory scholarship banner with Bank's portrait hangs on a school wall; cut inside to Bank himself hunched over a desk in a blue-lit classroom, writing hard, head down.

A fast run of near-black shots in a cramped cluttered laundry room: a figure hauls a bucket past the doorway, glimpses of someone working among hanging cloth, the frames darkening until the picture goes fully black.

Out of black into a bright school corridor: two girls walk away and a boy exits far down the hall, then a uniformed girl comes forward alone toward the lens. Cut to her phone lighting up with a message, 'come meet us at our place tonight'.
